issue.title: bundledDev: `memoryFiles` keeps every rebuild's hashed chunks and every HMR patch, so dev server memory grows with each edit
issue.body:
### Describe the bug With `experimental.bundledDev`, nothing is ever removed from `BundledDev.memoryFiles` until the server closes. - `storeOutputFiles` only calls `memoryFiles.set`. - `getRolldownOptions` forces `chunkFileNames: 'assets/[name]-[hash].js'` and `assetFileNames: 'assets/[name]-[hash][extname]'`. So every rebuild that changes a chunk stores it, and its source map, under a new name, next to all the previous copies. HMR patches (`hmr_patch_N.js` + `.map`) are never removed either. Every old file stays served. There are two ways to hit it. 1. **A chunk shared between entries** (multiple `rolldownOptions.input` entries, or `devMode: { lazy: false }` with dynamic imports). Each edit to a module in a shared chunk adds that chunk and its map again, plus every hashed chunk that imports it, because the hash change cascades. In our app, with ~230 entries, 20 edits to a module most entries import took `memoryFiles` from 1,919 to 28,479 files, and the process RSS from 3.9 GB to 12.1 GB. 2. **The default config with a page open.** Each edit adds `hmr_patch_N.js` and `hmr_patch_N.js.map`. That's slower growth, but it's unbounded for a long-running session. **Expected:** `memoryFiles` holds the latest build output, plus the patches that are still pending. **Actual:** it holds every file ever emitted. `storeOutputFiles` has `// NOTE: don't clear memoryFiles here as incremental build reuses the files`. In the reproduction, though, each rebuild hands `storeOutputFiles` the complete output, unchanged entries included. A possible fix: - Remember the previous output's file names, and delete the ones the new output does not contain. - Delete an HMR patch or lazy payload once the client reports it delivered (`vite:bundled-dev:payload-delivered`), or keep only the last few. A workaround for build output, not for HMR patches: a plugin that removes the hash, so each rebuild overwrites the same keys: ```js { name: 'unhashed-dev-chunks', outputOptions: options => ({ ...options, chunkFileNames: 'assets/[name].js', assetFileNames: 'assets/[name][extname]' }), } ``` ### Reproduction https://github.com/asapach/vite-issue-memoryfiles ### Steps to reproduce **Case 1, a chunk shared between two entries** (scripted): 1. `npm install` 2. `npm run repro` The script uses `bundledDev.memoryFiles` and `devEngine` internals only to count the files and to wait for each rebuild deterministically. It makes five code edits to `src/shared.js`, then restores it. **Case 2, the default config:** 1. `npm run dev` 2. Open http://localhost:5173/ 3. Edit `src/shared.js` and save, three times, with different code each time. 4. `curl -i http://localhost:5173/hmr_patch_0.js` returns 200, as do `hmr_patch_1.js` and `hmr_patch_2.js`. All of them stay in `memoryFiles` until the server closes. ### System Info ```shell System: OS: Windows 11 10.0.26100 CPU: (18) x64 Intel(R) Core(TM) Ultra 5 135H Memory: 9.03 GB / 31.46 GB Binaries: Node: 24.16.0 npm: 11.13.0 pnpm: 11.11.0 Browsers: Chrome: 155.0.8059.40 Edge: Chromium (152.0.4191.53) npmPackages: vite: 8.3.4 => 8.3.4 rolldown: 1.2.14 (dependency of vite) ``` ### Used Package Manager npm ### Logs
npm run repro ```shell initial build: 6 files after edit 1: 8 files after edit 2: 10 files after edit 3: 12 files after edit 4: 14 files after edit 5: 16 files assets/main.js assets/other.js assets/shared-1euN4Vmf.js assets/main.js.map assets/other.js.map assets/shared-1euN4Vmf.js.map assets/shared-Dt-zbz8f.js assets/shared-Dt-zbz8f.js.map assets/shared-BkId7QYW.js assets/shared-BkId7QYW.js.map assets/shared-DB4C89Nn.js assets/shared-DB4C89Nn.js.map assets/shared-BcUH7Yx-.js assets/shared-BcUH7Yx-.js.map assets/shared-CGgg6g2c.js assets/shared-CGgg6g2c.js.map GET /assets/shared-1euN4Vmf.js (initial build) -> 200, still the original code ```
Case 2: memoryFiles after three edits with the page open ```shell bundledDevClient.mjs, @rolldown/experimental-runtime.mjs, @vite/client, @vite/env, assets/index.js, assets/index.js.map, index.html, hmr_patch_0.js, hmr_patch_0.js.map, hmr_patch_1.js, hmr_patch_1.js.map, hmr_patch_2.js, hmr_patch_2.js.map GET /hmr_patch_1.js -> 200 ```
